1719-2645-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3755-4770-5223-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6529-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-6529-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2131-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5434-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5434-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-7730--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-7730--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-7730--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

193-2724-3194-4450.description:
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

2921-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
2921-7096--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

2060-3525-4597-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Shu Farmer does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Shu Farmer.
2060-3525-4597-6996.description:
Activate Shu Farmer by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Shu Farmer.
Repeat.

1806-1887-2060-2921-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

907-1257-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
907-1257-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5902-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5902-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
5902-7009-7334.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2097-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-5078-6766-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2366-5226-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5226-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-5663-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

147-780-997.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

2173-2324-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

7-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-4484-4871-5643-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

222-2060-3967-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-3967-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

198-2797-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn using Retrofitter Foundry's ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
198-2797-3918.notes: The costs are as follows: {3} if Trazyn has no charge counters, {1} if it has one charge counter, {0} otherwise. Once you have infinite mana, you can use Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities via Trazyn.

38-2420-6258.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-6258.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

3682-3771-4518-5542.manaNeeded: {1} if Animar does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
3682-3771-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-2143-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2143-4434-4762.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When the Eldrazi Spawns enter the battlefield as Treefolk due to Arcane Adaptation, Quickbeam triggers twice, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

725-1921-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion attached to Tawnos.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
725-1921-5296.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Workhorse from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Workhorse.
Activate the Workhorse token three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the Workhorse token, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Workhorse token and causing you to mill two cards .
Repeat from step 2.

1548-3742.notablePrerequisites:
Phantom Steed does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1548-3742.description:
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker, attacking any opponent that is unable to block and kill your creatures.
Phantom Steed's second ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Port Razer.
Deal combat damage with Phantom Steed and Port Razer.
Port Razer triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Port Razer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

618-813-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The token copy of Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp and any second instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1123-2034-4866.description:
Sacrifice Flayer to Altar, adding {C}{C} and triggering Undying and then Flayer's damage trigger.
Pay {2} to activate Sage of Fables, removing the counter from Flayer and drawing a card.
Note you may hold priority while the Sage of Fables draw trigger is on the stack and continue the combo without drawing cards to avoid decking.

1905-3413-4283-5295.notablePrerequisites: An additional creature on the battlefield.
1905-3413-4283-5295.description:
Activate Whisper, Blood Liturgist, sacrificing itself and an additional creature to return Volrath's Shapeshifter from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a zombie token.
Volrath's Shapeshifter enters the battlefield as a copy of Whisper, Blood Liturgist.
Activate Volrath's Shapeshifter, sacrificing itself and a zombie token to return Whisper, Blood Liturgist to the battlefield.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a zombie token.
